rule_version = 'expert_separated_sales_v3'::text OR rule_version = 'expert_energy_start_v2'::text OR (term_months = ANY (ARRAY[1, 3])) AND duration_seconds = (2592000::bigint * term_months) AND (term_months = 1 OR (quoted_at - calculation_timestamp) < '144:00:00'::interval) AND energy_discount_bps =
CASE
    WHEN (quoted_at - calculation_timestamp) < '72:00:00'::interval THEN 4000
    WHEN (quoted_at - calculation_timestamp) < '144:00:00'::interval THEN 3000
    WHEN (quoted_at - calculation_timestamp) < '216:00:00'::interval THEN 2000
    ELSE 0
END AND start_discount_bps =
CASE
    WHEN term_months = 1 THEN 0
    WHEN (quoted_at - calculation_timestamp) < '72:00:00'::interval THEN 1500
    ELSE 1000
END

expert_campaign_quote_time_valid.name: expert_campaign_quote_time_valid
expert_campaign_quote_time_valid.value: rule_version = 'expert_separated_sales_v3'::text OR rule_version = 'expert_energy_start_v2'::text OR isfinite(calculation_timestamp) AND isfinite(quoted_at) AND isfinite(expires_at) AND calculation_timestamp >= '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone AND calculation_timestamp <= quoted_at AND quoted_at < expires_at AND expires_at <= '275760-09-13 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone AND calculation_timestamp = date_trunc('milliseconds'::text, calculation_timestamp) AND quoted_at = date_trunc('milliseconds'::text, quoted_at) AND expires_at = date_trunc('milliseconds'::text, expires_at) AND expires_at <= (quoted_at + '00:15:00'::interval)

expert_campaign_quote_v2_valid.name: expert_campaign_quote_v2_valid
expert_campaign_quote_v2_valid.value:
rule_version = 'expert_separated_sales_v3'::text OR rule_version = 'expert_energy_start_v1'::text AND profile_revision IS NULL AND package_price_minor IS NULL OR rule_version = 'expert_energy_start_v2'::text AND profile_revision IS NOT NULL AND currency = 'RUB'::text AND isfinite(calculation_timestamp) AND isfinite(quoted_at) AND isfinite(expires_at) AND calculation_timestamp <= quoted_at AND quoted_at < expires_at AND ((quoted_at - calculation_timestamp) < '240:00:00'::interval OR expires_at <= (quoted_at + '24:00:00'::interval)) AND calculation_timestamp = date_trunc('milliseconds'::text, calculation_timestamp) AND quoted_at = date_trunc('milliseconds'::text, quoted_at) AND expires_at = date_trunc('milliseconds'::text, expires_at) AND idempotency_key ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,199}$'::text AND (term_months = ANY (ARRAY[1, 3])) AND duration_seconds = (2592000::bigint * term_months) AND (term_months = 1 OR (quoted_at - calculation_timestamp) < '168:00:00'::interval) AND energy_discount_bps =
CASE
    WHEN (quoted_at - calculation_timestamp) < '96:00:00'::interval THEN 4000
    WHEN (quoted_at - calculation_timestamp) < '168:00:00'::interval THEN 3000
    WHEN (quoted_at - calculation_timestamp) < '240:00:00'::interval THEN 2000
    ELSE 0
END AND base_monthly_minor >= 0 AND monthly_price_minor::numeric = GREATEST(500000::numeric, div(base_monthly_minor::numeric * (10000 - energy_discount_bps)::numeric + 5000::numeric, 10000::numeric)) AND discounted_monthly_minor::numeric = div(base_monthly_minor::numeric * (10000 - energy_discount_bps)::numeric + 5000::numeric, 10000::numeric) AND floor_applied =
CASE
    WHEN term_months = 1 THEN discounted_monthly_minor < 500000
    ELSE div(base_monthly_minor::numeric * 3::numeric * (10000 - energy_discount_bps)::numeric * (10000 - start_discount_bps)::numeric + 50000000::numeric, 100000000::numeric) < 1500000::numeric
END AND ((quoted_at - calculation_timestamp) >= '168:00:00'::interval AND package_price_minor IS NULL AND start_discount_bps = 0 OR (quoted_at - calculation_timestamp) < '168:00:00'::interval AND package_price_minor IS NOT NULL AND package_price_minor::numeric = GREATEST(1500000::numeric, div(base_monthly_minor::numeric * 3::numeric * (10000 - energy_discount_bps)::numeric * (10000 - start_discount_bps)::numeric + 50000000::numeric, 100000000::numeric))) AND price_minor =
CASE
    WHEN term_months = 1 THEN monthly_price_minor
    ELSE package_price_minor
END AND price_minor >= 1 AND price_minor <= '999999999999'::bigint

public.package_balances.name: package_balances
public.package_balances.definition: SELECT p.id AS package_id, p.user_id, COALESCE(sum(l.delta), 0::bigint)::integer AS balance FROM message_packages p LEFT JOIN message_ledger_entries l ON l.package_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.user_id

public.expert_referral_balances.name: expert_referral_balances
public.expert_referral_balances.definition: WITH ledger_totals AS ( SELECT expert_referral_ledger_entries.expert_id, COALESCE(sum(expert_referral_ledger_entries.amount_minor), 0::numeric)::bigint AS net_minor, COALESCE(- sum(expert_referral_ledger_entries.amount_minor) FILTER (WHERE expert_referral_ledger_entries.entry_kind = ANY (ARRAY['reservation'::expert_referral_ledger_entry_kind, 'release'::expert_referral_ledger_entry_kind])), 0::numeric)::bigint AS reserved_minor, COALESCE(sum(expert_referral_ledger_entries.amount_minor) FILTER (WHERE expert_referral_ledger_entries.entry_kind = 'reward_grant'::expert_referral_ledger_entry_kind), 0::numeric)::bigint AS granted_minor, COALESCE(- sum(expert_referral_ledger_entries.amount_minor) FILTER (WHERE expert_referral_ledger_entries.entry_kind = 'spend'::expert_referral_ledger_entry_kind), 0::numeric)::bigint AS spent_minor, COALESCE(- sum(expert_referral_ledger_entries.amount_minor) FILTER (WHERE expert_referral_ledger_entries.entry_kind = 'expiry'::expert_referral_ledger_entry_kind), 0::numeric)::bigint AS expired_minor FROM expert_referral_ledger_entries GROUP BY expert_referral_ledger_entries.expert_id ), grant_remaining AS ( SELECT g_1.id, g_1.expert_id, g_1.expires_at, COALESCE(sum(a.amount_minor), 0::numeric)::bigint AS remaining_minor FROM expert_referral_reward_grants g_1 LEFT JOIN expert_referral_ledger_allocations a ON a.reward_grant_id = g_1.id WHERE g_1.expires_at > transaction_timestamp() GROUP BY g_1.id, g_1.expert_id, g_1.expires_at HAVING sum(a.amount_minor) > 0::numeric ), grant_expiry AS ( SELECT grant_remaining.expert_id, min(grant_remaining.expires_at) AS nearest_expiry_at FROM grant_remaining GROUP BY grant_remaining.expert_id ) SELECT e.id AS expert_id, GREATEST(COALESCE(l.net_minor, 0::bigint), 0::bigint) AS available_credit_minor, GREATEST(COALESCE(l.reserved_minor, 0::bigint), 0::bigint) AS reserved_credit_minor, g.nearest_expiry_at, GREATEST(COALESCE(l.granted_minor, 0::bigint), 0::bigint) AS lifetime_granted_minor, GREATEST(COALESCE(l.spent_minor, 0::bigint), 0::bigint) AS lifetime_spent_minor, GREATEST(COALESCE(l.expired_minor, 0::bigint), 0::bigint) AS lifetime_expired_minor, GREATEST(- COALESCE(l.net_minor, 0::bigint), 0::bigint) AS debt_minor FROM experts e LEFT JOIN ledger_totals l ON l.expert_id = e.id LEFT JOIN grant_expiry g ON g.expert_id = e.id

public.resident_sales_application.name: resident_sales_application
public.resident_sales_application.definition: SELECT f.id, f.user_id, f.bot_id, f.bot_key, f.channel_identity_id, f.telegram_user_id, f.chat_id, f.revision, f.form_version, f.policy_version, f.education_requirement, f.draft, f.role_type, f.target_category, f.tax_status, f.location_city, f.social_links_json, f.motivation_text, f.education_refs_json, f.property_refs_json, f.system_check_result, f.manager_notes, f.current_field, f.status, f.progress, f.submitted_draft, f.submitted_at, f.created_at, f.updated_at, b.base_tariff_amount, b.base_offer_shown_at, s.promo_accepted_flag, l.final_locked_price, s.offer_expiry_date, s.monthly_price_minor, s.package_price_minor, s.selected_total_minor, s.term_months, CASE WHEN l.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'ONBOARDING_STARTED'::text WHEN clock_timestamp() >= (b.base_offer_shown_at + '240:00:00'::interval) THEN 'STANDARD_TARIFF_LOCKED'::text ELSE 'UNPAID'::text END AS sales_status FROM residents_applications f JOIN expert_sales_bases b ON b.user_id = f.user_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT s_1.id, s_1.base_id, s_1.user_id, s_1.choice_id, s_1.promo_accepted_flag, s_1.term_months, s_1.monthly_price_minor, s_1.package_price_minor, s_1.selected_total_minor, s_1.energy_discount_bps, s_1.package_discount_bps, s_1.selected_at, s_1.offer_expiry_date FROM expert_sales_selections s_1 WHERE s_1.base_id = b.id ORDER BY s_1.selected_at DESC, s_1.id DESC LIMIT 1) s ON true LEFT JOIN expert_sales_paid_locks l ON l.user_id = f.user_id
